$comment: The dicing host (plugins/bots/gamble/DiceBot.PlayerBots.js). Stand where you want it and type ::dicebot (owner) to put it there; the tile is saved to bot-dice-spot.json and it comes back there every restart. ::dicebot off removes it. Game: the host rolls 1-100 and pays multiplier x the bet when the roll is above winAbove (55x2: 56-100 wins, 45%). Bets are coins and platinum tokens only, between minBet and maxBet.
name: 55x2 Dicing

ads: 55x2 open | coins or plat tokens | 100k min
hosting 55x2 | instant payouts | trade to bet
coins 100k - 1b or plat tokens up to 1b | paid in kind
lose: rolled {roll} - house wins, gl next time {name}
busy: one at a time pls, rolling for someone
busy rolling, trade me in a sec
coinsOnly: coins or plat tokens only pls
tooHigh: max bet is {max} coins or {maxTokens} plat
roomFirst: {name} your stack is too big for the payout, bank some and trade me
bank some gp first {name}, then trade me for your payout
queued: in line {name} (#{position}), trade coming after this one

$bankroll: The host keeps 2,147m coins and 2,147m platinum tokens in its inventory, topped back up after every game. Bets: coins 100k-1b and/or platinum tokens 1-1b; a win pays multiplier x each, in the same kind (tokens back as tokens).
